item.title: Authorities begin exercise of inspecting lockers of docs, medical staff in hospitals
item.description: Srinagar: Authorities in Jammu and Kashmir on Wednesday began the exercise of inspecting the lockers of doctors and medical staff in hospitals as part of enhanced security measures after the recent Delhi blast and recovery of arms and ammunition in the "white collar" terror module, officials said.
